notes.title: Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello world! We are back with new features!
Thank you all for the support, we received a really good feedback, and we want to share more of the features we are working on. As always, any comments and suggestions are welcome.

https://youtu.be/_teLoi9PH7g


This is what's coming:

 + 2 NEW WORLDS

 Nature 
 Steampunk

+ 3 NEW CHARACTERS

 Ayu
 Juanita
 Simone

+ 3 NEW WEAPONS  

 Whip   
 Shuriken
 Sledge Hammer

+ 2 NEW POWER UPS

 Super Dash
 Reveal

+ 1 NEW GAME MODE

 King of the Light

+ Even more BUG FIXES!  

We hope you  enjoy the game and if you help us by doing a review it will be awesome!

notes.title: Patch Notes | Shadow Brawlers
notes.content:
Hey Ninjas!

Updated and Fixed Stuff


 New Input systems should work with (almost) any GamePad 
 We lowered a bit the time needed to unlock characters, weapons, powerups and game modes
 Optional Access to the Beta version of the Replay Feature (use with discretion) 
 Fixed Input Configuration for Keyboard
 A new special stage at the end of the challenge mode
 Now 'Patata' is unlocked by completing all challenge mode levels
 Now 'SteamB' (temp name) gets unlocked in ruins (instead of Patata)
 New PowerUp "Decoy" available! 
 Lowering audio and music volume now makes sense!
 Some scenery elements from several maps where revised
 A few informative popups added here and there
 Updated the animation on Chaos Saw and Chaos Destiny to better reflect while they are not dangerous
 Bot distribution in some challenge mode maps where updated
 Added a Vfx when a secret mobility exploit is used
 Fixed a thing where selecting palettes manually was futile
 Fixed a thing with the input that snapped the attack direction to rectangular angles sometimes
 We updated some texts and some menus details
  Fixed a lot of minor stuff, mostly achievements



 Join us Ninja! 

Discord:https://discord.gg/9pgKrzw

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33517250/0ed32358b75afa05827cb3029d2576f5e88aba3b.png
